mirtverse: a friendly workflow and reporting layer for mirt

Source: R/mirtverse-package.R
mirtverse-package.Rd

mirtverse builds on the mirt package. It adds tidy outputs (tidy(), glance(), augment()), ggplot2 graphics (gg_trace(), gg_info(), gg_wright() and friends), an automatic model selection assistant (select_model()), plain-language interpretation (interpret()), item health cards (item_card()), one-call HTML reports (mv_report()), results dashboards to share (mv_dashboard()), a point-and-click workbench (launch_workbench()) and a joint model for responses and response times (fit_rt()), and a translator from ltm, eRm, TAM and irtQ code to mirt code (mirtify()).
